description: Force /api/*, /vdp/* and /inventory/* to Pages Functions. /api/* prevents GET fallthrough to static 404 before the dispatcher. The /admin area was removed 2026-10-18 (the OBD helper moved into the DMS). /vdp/* runs the legacy DealerCenter VDP resolver (2026-08-10) — DC syndicates /vdp/<DCID>-<stock>/ links to CarGurus and they were all 404ing. /inventory/* runs functions/inventory/[slug].ts, which had NEVER executed in production because it was missing from this list (2026-08-11) — that is why sold VDPs 404 instead of returning its 410 Gone page. Static sub-assets under /_next/* are unaffected.
